reason_codes.meaning: All due observations are complete, fresh, reconciled, and unchanged with no unmatched or urgent signal.
A genuine observed difference opens one new bounded affected-work unit without deciding legal effect.
A genuine observed difference is bound to an already open affected-work unit.
A due release-blocking Observation is stale, failed, partial, malformed, unreconciled, or otherwise unavailable.
An unavailable item-specific Observation blocks only work that depends on it.
